brief: The canvas showcases a complex, rotating steampunk kinetic sculpture dominated by rich, oxidized metallic surfaces covered in verdigris patina. At its core, a solid, rotating cube glows intensely with thick, viscous molten bronze, which features distinct internal currents of liquid fire. Orbiting around this luminous core are intricate splines, appearing to be crafted from tarnished copper and segments of sea glass. These splines constantly rotate in patterned orbits, dynamically catching and reflecting the vibrant, intense glow of the molten center, creating a mesmerizing display of engineered mechanics and raw, subterranean heat.
